submitted_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Never use Pyro Jack, Jack Frost or Pixie in this card. Replace the kicking leg and figure with JUNPEI in a flying kick along the same line, his sneaker smashing into the same spot among the blue crystals, his baseball cap flying off his head. The small figure watching at the left becomes a small SHADOW cowering. Keep the tan stone block, the crystals, the impact flash and the red-orange background. Character and object designs: [JUNPEI] = JUNPEI IORI: messy brown hair under a baseball cap, loose school uniform, a wide cheeky grin. [SHADOW] = P3R SHADOW: a blob of glossy black ooze with a few dripping tendrils, wearing one pale mask with a simple stylised face (give it a mask design different from a plain white oval with eye slits).
Image2 is the original P3R exported Junpei design reference ONLY. Follow the recognizable face, brown hair and baseball cap design, but the cap is flying OFF his head as specified. Do not copy the portrait crop, pose or background. No cap lettering or symbols.
